nodes.Name: Reader
nodes.DocComment:
A Reader implements the [io.Reader], [io.ReaderAt], [io.WriterTo], [io.Seeker],
[io.ByteScanner], and [io.RuneScanner] interfaces by reading from
a byte slice.
Unlike a [Buffer], a Reader is read-only and supports seeking.
The zero value for Reader operates like a Reader of an empty slice.

nodes.Name: Len
nodes.DocComment:
Len returns the number of bytes of the unread portion of the
slice.

nodes.Name: Size
nodes.DocComment:
Size returns the original length of the underlying byte slice.
Size is the number of bytes available for reading via [Reader.ReadAt].
The result is unaffected by any method calls except [Reader.Reset].

nodes.Name: UnreadByte
nodes.DocComment: UnreadByte complements [Reader.ReadByte] in implementing the [io.ByteScanner] interface.

nodes.Name: UnreadRune
nodes.DocComment: UnreadRune complements [Reader.ReadRune] in implementing the [io.RuneScanner] interface.

nodes.Name: Reset
nodes.DocComment: Reset resets the [Reader] to be reading from b.

nodes.Name: NewReader
nodes.DocComment: NewReader returns a new [Reader] reading from b.
